prerequisites: IGENI-EC0244 Structures électriques en courant continu
IGENI-EC0445 Circuits électriques en régime alternatif
IGENI-EC0743 Conversion statique de l'énergie électrique 1

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and its importance in the design of electronic and electrotechnical systems.
Identify the main sources of electromagnetic disturbance (emissions) and coupling mechanisms (conducted and radiated).
Understand the effects of electromagnetic interference on sensitive equipment (immunity).
Learn basic methods for limiting risks (shielding, filtering, grounding, routing rules, etc.).
Acquire an initial overview of the standards framework and project management incorporating EMC constraints (industrial standards and compliance testing).

syllabus_topics: General overview of the criticality of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) issues for the operational safety of electronic and electrotechnical systems
General overview of the standards framework and EMC project management
Fundamental physics: parasitic impedances, radiated and conducted electromagnetic disturbances.
EMC compliance testing: emission and immunity
bibliography: Alain Charoy « Guide pratique de la CEM - 3e édition », Dunod 2017
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
